description: This file provides utility functions for encrypting and decrypting data using CryptoJS, specifically AES-128-ECB encryption. It includes functions for handling tenant IDs, string encryption/decryption, and safe decryption methods with error handling.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using AES-128-ECB with a salt, returning a Base64 string without padding.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a Base64 string (with optional padding) encrypted with AES-128-ECB, returning the original string.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID using the default tenant salt.

methods.name: encryptString
methods.description: Wrapper function to encrypt any string with the default tenant salt.

methods.name: decryptString
methods.description: Wrapper function to decrypt any string with the default tenant salt.

methods.name: decryptStringClipboard
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt a string; if it fails, returns the original value.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Safely decrypts an encrypted tenant ID, returning null if decryption fails.

methods.name: getRootTenantId
methods.description: Returns the static root tenant ID from environment variable.
